people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
translations.bsb: The remaining descendants of Kohath received ten cities by lot from the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
translations.kjv: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
translations.asv: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
